skills.name: Standard position
skills.wrong_turn: Negative angles go clockwise. −90° points straight down, not left.
skills.rule: Standard position: vertex at the origin, initial side on the positive x-axis, counterclockwise positive.

skills.name: Coterminal angles
skills.wrong_turn: Coterminal means differing by whole turns. 30° and 210° differ by half a turn and point in opposite directions.
skills.rule: θ and θ+360°k are coterminal; in radians, θ+2πk.

skills.name: Unit circle definition

steps.a: cos as x, sin as y

skills.wrong_turn: On the unit circle, cosine is the x-coordinate and sine is the y-coordinate, not the other way round.
skills.rule: The point at angle θ on the unit circle is (cosθ,sinθ), and tanθ=(yx).

skills.name: Special angles

steps.d: common angles by heart, in degrees and radians

skills.wrong_turn: sin 60° is not 2 × sin 30° = 1. It is √3/2 ≈ 0.87: doubling the angle doesn't double the sine.
skills.rule: sin30°=(12), sin45°=(22), sin60°=(32); cosines run the other way.

skills.name: Reference angles
skills.wrong_turn: Reference angles are measured to the x-axis, never the y-axis. For 120°, it is 60°, not 30°.
skills.rule: The reference angle is the acute angle between the terminal side and the x-axis.

skills.name: Signs by quadrant
skills.wrong_turn: A negative sine doesn't make the angle negative. sin 200° < 0, but 200° is a positive angle in Quadrant III.
skills.rule: All are positive in Quadrant I, sine in II, tangent in III, cosine in IV.

skills.name: Trig of any angle
skills.wrong_turn: r is always positive. For (−3, −4), r = 5, not −5, so sin θ = −4/5 and cos θ = −3/5.
skills.rule: For (x,y) on the terminal side, with r=x2+y2: sinθ=(yr), cosθ=(xr), tanθ=(yx).

skills.name: Graph sine & cosine
skills.wrong_turn: Sine starts at 0, cosine starts at 1. The graphs have the same shape, shifted by π/2.
skills.rule: y=sinx and y=cosx repeat every 2π and stay between −1 and 1.

skills.name: Amplitude & period
skills.wrong_turn: The period of sin(Bx) is 2π/B, not 2πB. sin 2x repeats twice as often: every π.
skills.rule: y=Asin(Bx) has amplitude |A| and period (2πB), for B>0.

skills.name: Phase & vertical shift
skills.wrong_turn: Factor B out first. In sin(2x − π), the shift is π/2 to the right, not π.
skills.rule: y=Asin(B(x−C))+D: shift right by C, midline y=D.

skills.name: Periodic models
skills.wrong_turn: Amplitude is half the range, not the maximum. A tide from 1 m to 5 m has amplitude 2 m and midline 3 m.
skills.rule: Fit y=Asin(B(t−C))+D: D is the middle, |A| half the range, B=(2πperiod).

skills.name: Graph tangent
skills.wrong_turn: tan x has asymptotes where cos x = 0, not where sin x = 0. At x = 0, tan x = 0.
skills.rule: y=tanx has period π and vertical asymptotes at x=(π2)+kπ.

skills.name: Reciprocal function graphs
skills.wrong_turn: The reciprocal isn't the inverse. csc x = 1/sin x is a number; sin⁻¹ x = arcsin x is an angle.
skills.rule: cscx=(1sinx), secx=(1cosx), cotx=(1tanx): asymptotes where the partner is 0.

skills.name: Inverse trig functions
skills.wrong_turn: arccos returns angles from 0 to π, not −π/2 to π/2. arccos(−1/2) = 2π/3, not −π/3.

skills.name: Inverse trig compositions
skills.wrong_turn: arcsin(sin x) = x fails outside −π/2 to π/2. arcsin(sin π) = 0, not π.
skills.rule: sin(arcsinx)=x for x∈[−1,1], but arcsin(sinx)=x only for x∈[−(π2),(π2)].
